zh: 吃饱了 修炼更有劲。
en: Full now — more energy to cultivate.

zh: 这顿饭顶三天辟谷。
en: This meal beats three days of fasting.

zh: 民以食为天 修仙也不例外。
en: Even cultivators must eat.

zh: 再饿下去就要走火入魔了。
en: Any hungrier and I'd go qi-deviant.

zh: 二狗一定没我吃得好。
en: Bet Ergou doesn't eat this well.

zh: 吃饱才有力气偷懒。
en: Gotta eat well to slack off properly.

zh: 灵气没多少 饭量倒不小。
en: Low on qi big on appetite.

zh: 这顿先不修炼 消化要紧。
en: No cultivating now — digesting first.

zh: 大鱼大肉才扛得住练功。
en: Only meat and rice fuel real training.

zh: 练武之人 一顿三碗饭。
en: A martial artist eats three bowls a meal.

zh: 吃饱了去捶那木人桩。
en: Time to go pound the wooden dummy.

zh: 这身肌肉都是饭喂出来的。
en: These muscles are fed by rice.

zh: 师父说饿着肚子打不出真气。
en: Master says you can't punch qi on empty.

zh: 补充体力 下午继续扎马步。
en: Refuel — more horse stance this afternoon.

zh: 吃完这顿能扛半座矿。
en: After this I could haul half a mine.

zh: 大碗喝酒大块吃肉才痛快。
en: Big bowls big meat — that's the life.

zh: 服一枚聚气丹 五谷已是多余。
en: One qi pill and grain feels redundant.

zh: 丹入腹中 灵气自生。
en: The pill dissolves and qi arises.

zh: 凡间烟火 早已不入口了。
en: Mortal food no longer passes my lips.

zh: 一粒丹药 抵得上一桌酒席。
en: One pill outvalues a whole banquet.

zh: 辟谷多日 唯丹可餐。
en: Fasting for days — only pills will do.

zh: 药力化开 周身经脉俱暖。
en: The pill's warmth spreads through my meridians.

zh: 这丹火候差了些 凑合咽下。
en: The pill's a touch off but it'll do.

zh: 以丹代食 方显修士本色。
en: Pills over rice — the mark of a true cultivator.

zh: 吞吐灵气 已近不食之境。
en: Drawing in qi — nearly beyond eating now.

zh: 一缕灵气入腹 胜过千钟粟。
en: A wisp of qi beats a thousand bushels of grain.

zh: 丹药于我 也不过点心罢了。
en: Even pills are mere snacks to me now.

zh: 辟谷已成 聊以丹药佐茶。
en: Past hunger now — a pill just goes with tea.
